# Кошка Шрёдингера / Schrödinger’s Cat

> A Russian/English literary and philosophical website by Elena Berezina, with articles in both languages, Russian poetry, and Russian-language books.

Discussions of physics, time, cosmology, and philosophy present the author's reflections and hypotheses, not established scientific conclusions. Language availability differs by work, as noted below. This file is a guide to published content and does not grant permission for AI indexing or training.

## Articles in Russian and English

- [Статьи](https://schrodingercat.org/articles/): Russian article collection, with 26 articles across three listing pages and links to their English versions.
- [Articles](https://schrodingercat.org/en/articles/): English versions of the same 26 articles, across three listing pages.

## Переборщ / Pereborsh (Russian only)

- [Переборщ](https://schrodingercat.org/proza/pereborsh/): Elena Berezina's unfinished autofiction novel, published on this site in Russian. The table of contents links to the introduction and 27 chapters. No English translation is available on this site.
- [Вступление — start reading online](https://schrodingercat.org/proza/pereborsh/vstuplenie/): Russian introduction, with chapter navigation.
- [Download Pereborsh as PDF](https://schrodingercat.org/assets/books/pereborsh.pdf): Russian-language novel.
- [Download Pereborsh as EPUB](https://schrodingercat.org/assets/books/pereborsh.epub): Russian-language novel.

## Other Russian sections and book

- [Кошка Шрёдингера](https://schrodingercat.org/): Russian homepage.
- [Поэзия](https://schrodingercat.org/poeziya/): Poems in Russian; the listing spans three pages.
- [Проза](https://schrodingercat.org/proza/): Prose section featuring «Переборщ».
- [Кошка Шрёдингера о теории всего в стиле «пэчворк»](https://schrodingercat.org/kniga/): Elena Berezina's Russian-language collection of reflections on physics, cosmology, and philosophy, with a PDF download.
- [Download the Russian-language collection as PDF](https://schrodingercat.org/assets/books/koshka-shredingera.pdf): «Кошка Шрёдингера о теории всего в стиле “пэчворк”».
- [О проекте](https://schrodingercat.org/about/): About text in Russian.

## English navigation and availability

- [Schrödinger’s Cat](https://schrodingercat.org/en/): English homepage.
- [Poetry](https://schrodingercat.org/en/poetry/): English availability page linking to Russian poems; English poetry translations are not available on this site.
- [Prose](https://schrodingercat.org/en/prose/): English availability page linking to the Russian prose and «Переборщ»; no English novel translation is available.
- [Book](https://schrodingercat.org/en/book/): English availability page linking to the Russian-language collection and its PDF; no English book translation is available.
- [About](https://schrodingercat.org/en/about/): About text in English.

## Site indexes

- [Все произведения](https://schrodingercat.org/works/): Russian work catalog.
- [All works](https://schrodingercat.org/en/works/): English work catalog, noting when a work is available only in Russian.
- [Sitemap](https://schrodingercat.org/sitemap.xml): Public HTML page URLs, including articles, poems, novel chapters, and pagination pages.
